title: HashMap (Map)
definition: A Hash Map stores key-value pairs and provides O(1) average time complexity for insertions, deletions, and lookups using a hashing function.
simpleExplanation: A giant dictionary where every word instantly tells you what page it's on without having to flip through the book.
